runs.summary: Data through Nov 6 (Q4 27-day partial). Top 3: XLE +40.6%, SMH +28.8%, CIBR +27.8%. SPY P/E: 23.05x
runs.content:
Top 5 YTD 2026: XLE +40.6% (P/E 13.53x, Cheap), SMH +28.8% (24.43x, Fair), CIBR +27.8% (31.11x, Elevated), XBI +25.0% (19.55x*, Fair, profitable holdings only), XLV +20.9% (32.72x, Elevated).

Bottom 5 YTD 2026: XLC -10.2% (15.12x, Fair), XME -9.6% (15.32x, Fair), GLD -6.0% (P/E N/A), ITA -3.4% (28.32x, Elevated), XLY -0.9% (26.67x, Elevated).

Notable shifts: sharp risk-off week. SPY fell ~2.7% (Q4 -3.6%, YTD +8.7%). Last week's leaders fell hardest: XLE ~-12% (Q4 +13.8% -> +0.2%), SMH ~-11% (Q4 -23.8%), CIBR ~-10%, XLK ~-8%. Moves checked against daily closes. GDX rallied ~13.6% (YTD back to +2.1%). Five band crossings: XLE Fair -> Cheap, XLC Cheap -> Fair, SMH Elevated -> Fair, XLP Elevated -> Fair, CIBR Expensive -> Elevated; no sector is Expensive now. Momentum: XLE Accelerating -> Consolidating, XLK Consolidating -> Fading, AMLP Continuing -> Fading (first negative 2026 quarter), GDX/JETS/XLY Reversing -> Fading. Defensives held Q4 (XLP +11.8%, KIE +9.9%, XLV +9.7%). 12 of 25 sectors beat SPY YTD; negative-YTD count fell 8 -> 5.

runs.content:

Notable shifts: CIBR gave back last week's bounce (~-4.8%; Q4 +2.9% -> -2.0%), fell back to #3 behind SMH, and moved Continuing -> Consolidating. Its P/E (35.09x) is only just Expensive.
